notes: Clicked for credits for six straight turns up to 35 credits while holding a full grip and never installing or running, and never trashed the naked Prana Condenser that built up counters and flatlined it.

Left R&D unprotected for eight turns while clicking for credits at 12+, discarded Project Beale into an open Archives where it was stolen, and overdrew into discards; otherwise a coherent Pivot/End of the Line and Lady Liberty win.

Repeatedly ran R&D three or four times a turn seeing the same top card (four Behold! hits in one turn), sat at 0 credits with tags against NBN for many turns, and facechecked net-damage ice twice in a row with a tiny grip; won only because the Corp decked.
Sensible Weyland play: early Hedge Funds, Trojan Horse on Echelon, iced remotes and three Send a Message scores; credits ran very low mid-game but the plan held.
Good pressure on HQ and R&D with sensible tag management and a well-timed Cupellation plus Overclock finish; ended a turn tagged at 0 credits and ate End of the Line, but survived.

Kept Bellona in an HQ guarded only by Virtual Service Agent where it was stolen, shuffled False Lead into an open R&D, then spent five turns clicking for credits at 13-23 credits while discarding and never scoring.
Ran a second naked Jinteki remote into another Byte! with a small grip and clicked for credits at 10+ several times, but built a working Audrey/Devil Charm rig and won off Archives agendas.
Early steals and Burner/Trick Shot play were sharp, but it then ran R&D three or four times a turn seeing the same top card for several turns instead of building econ or hitting the naked remote.

Installed no ice for five turns while clicking for credits, never iced R&D, and burned eight clicks and most of its credits trashing resources while the Runner walked into HQ and R&D for every agenda.

Against a Runner who did nothing for 25 turns, it hoarded 30-45 credits, kept playing Government Subsidy and advancing ice for Built to Last money, drew aggressively, scored only twice and lost to decking.
Scored behind Semak-samun competently, but left Archives open while overdrawing and discarding, letting the Runner steal See How They Run and Fujii from the bin.

Facechecked R&D at 0 credits early but made a strong Degree Mill steal, then spent about ten turns clicking for credits and running an empty Archives before finally hitting HQ with Cupellation for the win.

Put a second agenda into the same one-ice remote the Runner had just broken into, then clicked for credits for six turns with HQ and R&D behind only Ping and Virtual Service Agent until the Runner stole out.

Sat at 0 credits for eight turns running an open R&D three or four times a turn into the same top card, then facechecked HQ tagged with a small grip against NBN and was flatlined by a foreseeable End of the Line.

Built a reasonable rig and stole one Send a Message, but ran an empty triple-iced remote into Winchester, paid 5 repeatedly to break into HQ for nothing, and never contested the final advanced remote.

Clicked for credits while flooded with agendas in an HQ behind only Virtual Service Agent, never installed an agenda, and chose to trash Stoke the Embers to an unprotected Archives off sabotage; lost on turn 7.
Slightly loose start with an underfunded HQ facecheck and a few credit clicks, then efficient Aumakua runs on R&D and HQ with Hermes and WAKE for a quick turn-9 win.
Built a five-ice remote and then left it empty while agendas piled up in an HQ guarded only by Anansi, clicking for credits at low money until the Runner stole four agendas from HQ.
Tight net-damage kill: Phoneutria on R&D punished repeated runs, Bladderwort and Mindscaping finished a Runner who emptied their own grip; too short a game to judge more.

Never installed a breaker or played its grip for most of the game, ran an open R&D four times a turn into the same card, then clicked for credits for three turns while the Corp scored out of one-ice remotes.
